What a drafting answer changes

Source: R/ai_diff.R
tfl_ai_diff.Rd

Compares the current state with a read answer (tfl_ai_parse()), item by item, for a review where each item is accepted or rejected.

Usage

tfl_ai_diff(current, answer, task = NULL)

Arguments

current

What there is now: toc, a data frame of TOC rows (tfl_read_toc()'s fields as columns; NULL for none); figure, a tfl_fig_design() (NULL for none). A tfl_ai_answer is accepted too.

answer

A tfl_ai_answer, or what current is.

task

One of tfl_ai_tasks(); by default the answer's.

Value

A data frame, one row an item and, for a changed item, one a changed field: part (toc, or the section), key (the output id; the piece's name, with #2 for a second one of a name), status (added, changed, removed, moved, same), field, was, now (for changed the field's values; for moved the positions).

Details

  • toc: the rows matched by output_id; a changed row has one row a changed column.

  • figure: the pieces of each section (data, layers) matched by their step / layer name in order of appearance (the second point layer with the second); the figure-wide plot settings as one piece, field by field; the design's template, ggplot2_version and compose as the piece design. A piece that keeps its fields but changes its order relative to the others is moved (one inserted in the middle moves nothing). A composed figure's plots are compared plot by plot (plots$km/layers ...).

Examples

cur <- tfl_fig_template("km_simple")
new <- cur
new$layers <- c(new$layers, list(list(layer = "censor_mark", shape = "x")))
new$plot$x_label <- "Time (Months)"
d <- tfl_ai_diff(cur, new, "figure")
d[d$status != "same", ]
#>      part           key status field  was now
#> 10 layers censor_mark#2  added  <NA> <NA>   3
